mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_category c LEFT JOIN t_test t ON t.category_id = c.id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, c.status, c.sort_no, c.update_date
